title: Output Width Time Budget
statement: Let $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, let $E$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $T_E:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be monotone. Suppose that on every Boolean input $r$, $E$ halts within $T_E(|r|)$ steps with output the binary representation of $f(|r|)$. For Boolean words $s$ and $w$ with $|s|\le |w|+1$, $E$ computes that binary representation on input $s$ within $T_E(|s|)$ steps; its length is at most $T_E(|s|)$, and $T_E(|s|)\le T_E(|w|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $E$ over the Boolean alphabet

replaced:
Let a machine $E$ compute the binary width word $s \mapsto
